_about: One battle scene per operation. `accent` is the operation's ENCOUNTER accent (flat pixel B color ownership): in battle it drives the header battle count and rule and the enemy card frames and name headers, nothing else. `wall_texture`, `floor_texture`, `edge_accent` and `streak` feed the v3 perspective scene (debug F9 only). Colours are PixelUI token names, never hexes. Empty fields draw the bare scene. Operations without an entry use `fallback`. The dice tray floor (Kev, 2026-10-17, DECISIONS_RESOLVED G-76): `tray_floor` names the entry of `tray_floors` every operation uses; a scene entry may set its own `tray_floor` to override it (none do). There is no battle backdrop image (G-76): battle and in-run screens show the plain dark background token.

grate_ember._about: Drawn in code at art resolution (tray size / 4 design px), NEAREST at 4x (battle_bay_floor.gd build_floor_image). Rows: art y % slat_period == 0 is `slat`, == 1 `slat_dim`, the rest `void`. The ember glow sits in void rows only: `ember` where a 4x4 Bayer threshold is under clamp((y/H - ember_start) / (1 - ember_start), 0, 1) * ember_max. Support frame: `frame_columns` from each side. Recessed lip: the outermost px `lip`, then 2 px `lip_shade` on top and left, `lip_lit` on bottom and right. Reticle: a 1 px ring at `reticle_radius` in four arcs with `reticle_gap_degrees` gaps at 0/90/180/270, and a full ring at `reticle_core_radius`.
